title: small on purpose.
lead: etheit is a website automation agency in dhaka, run by sharukhi.
storyQuote: the expensive part of most online businesses isn't the website. it's the manual work wrapped around it.
story: sharukhi is a self-taught developer. he started with browser extensions and python scripts, moved on to web apps, and kept noticing the same thing: the expensive part of most online businesses isn't the website. it's the manual work wrapped around it.
etheit exists to remove that work. we build the connections between your website and everything else, test them on real data, and write down how they work.
we stay small so the person you talk to is the person who builds it.

principles.title: boring on purpose
principles.body: we pick tools that will still work in three years. a quiet automation is a good automation.

principles.title: readable logs
principles.body: every run writes down what it did. when something fails you get a plain message, not a stack trace.

principles.title: plain quotes
principles.body: a fixed price after the first call. no retainer you didn't ask for.

crewLead: four mascots keep the studio honest. each one stands for something we automate. calm when it's automated, panicking when it isn't. poke one.

crew.name: pip
crew.line: gets nervous when a spreadsheet is involved.

crew.name: bolt
crew.line: wants to know what happens if the callback never arrives.

crew.name: nook
crew.line: has never once been caught up.

crew.name: scrap
crew.line: runs at 6am so you don't have to.

foundersSub: two people, one studio. you talk to the people who build it.

founders.name: sharukhi
founders.bio: self-taught developer. started with browser extensions and python scripts, then web apps. builds the integrations and writes down how they work.
